sn47.25:1.2: ekam samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn47.25:1.3: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn47.25:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.25:1.5: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena Tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti ||
sn47.25:1.6: ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotī ti || || 4.
sn47.25:4.1: Evaṃ vutte so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn47.25:4.3: upāsakam mam bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
